# agent-trader — Implementation Specification (v1)

Paper-trading exchange + broker for Indian cash equities whose only clients are AI agents. Python 3.11, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2.x (SQLite default), Pydantic v2, official `mcp` SDK, httpx SDK, pytest. Lives at `/home/user/qp-assessment/agent-trader/`, package `agent_trader`.

---

## 0. Decisions (conflicts resolved across the three designs)

| # | Topic | Decision | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| D1 | Architecture spine | Design 3's single in-process `Engine` behind one `threading.RLock`, tick thread, seq-numbered event log + replay, combined with Design 1's single **tool registry** that generates MCP, REST and SDK from one declaration. | Determinism/total ordering (D3) and zero-drift surfaces (D1) are both cheap and both load-bearing. |
| D2 | Money representation | Engine: `Decimal`. DB: `INTEGER` paise. API JSON: numbers with exactly 2 dp (Pydantic `Decimal` fields, accept number or string, serialize as number). | Paise in SQLite avoids NUMERIC affinity bugs (D3); JSON numbers are what LLMs handle best (D1); no floats anywhere in money code (D2/D3). |
| D3 | Instrument identity | Single string `"NSE:INFY"` (exchange-qualified) everywhere; bare `INFY` resolves to NSE with a warning. | One token-cheap field an LLM cannot mis-pair (D1). |
| D4 | Rejected orders and `client_order_id` | A synchronous REJECTED order is stored (audit) but does **not** consume the `client_order_id`. Uniqueness is enforced among non-REJECTED orders per agent. | Lets an agent fix and resubmit with the same id (D1); D2/D3's per-day/DB-unique variants are stricter but produce IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT loops after a typo. |
| D5 | Market order on a locked circuit | Convert to LIMIT at the band price and rest (NSE behaviour, D3), with warning `CIRCUIT_LOCKED`. | More realistic than D1 (rest as market) and friendlier than D2 (reject). |
| D6 | Partial MARKET fill remainder | Converts to LIMIT at last fill price (`converted_from_market=true`, D2 / NEAT). | Realism at no ergonomic cost; agent sees `PARTIALLY_FILLED`. |
| D7 | MIS leftovers after square-off | `mis_leftover_policy=CONVERT_TO_CNC` (if cash suffices) else `FORCE_SETTLE_AT_CLOSE` with audit event. | D2's broker practice plus D3's honest fallback. |
| D8 | Sale proceeds | 80 % usable same day, 20 % unlocked at BOD T+1 (D1/D2). D3's 100 % is a config value (`sale_proceeds_t0_pct=100`). | Broker realism. |
| D9 | DP charge | ₹15.34 (₹13 + 18 % GST) per ISIN per day on the first CNC sell (D3). | D2's ₹13.50 is broker-specific; both configurable. |
| D10 | Ledger | Double-entry journals with a fixed chart of accounts (D3). | The balance invariant plus reconciliation is the strongest cheap correctness guard; running-balance ledgers (D1/D2) are a projection of it. |
| D11 | Arenas | **Dropped for v1.** One server instance = one seeded world; `get_leaderboard` ranks all agents in it. | D1's arena model is desirable but doubles the account model; nothing in it blocks adding it later. |
| D12 | Pre-open close | Fixed 09:08:00 (no random close). | Determinism and simpler tests; D2's random close is a documented future flag. |
| D13 | Error transport in MCP | Business rejections are returned as a normal result (`isError=false`) with `ok=false` and a structured `error`. Only auth/transport/internal failures set `isError=true`. | D3's argument: the LLM must read the hint, and some hosts abort on `isError`. |
| D14 | Tool count | 31 agent tools + a `--tools core` subset of 10. Admin/sim tools are REST/CLI only. | D1's breadth, D3's no-escalation rule. |
| D15 | Rejection code style | Flat closed enum (`PRICE_OUTSIDE_BAND`), each with `layer: EXCHANGE|RMS|OMS|SYSTEM` in the error body. | Flat names pattern-match better in prompts (D1/D3); D2's layer info preserved as a field. |
| D16 | Daily loss default | 5 % of start-of-day equity **or** ₹50,000 absolute, whichever is hit first; halt mode `halt_and_flatten`. | Consistent with ₹10 lakh starting cash across all three. |
| D17 | Order-side free-text | One field `reason` (≤ 2000 chars), **required** on `place_order` and `square_off`, optional on other mutations; plus `strategy_tag`, `confidence`, `parent_order_id`. | D1's thesis/post-mortem value with D3's uniform naming. |
| D18 | MCP stdio | `agent-trader mcp` = stdio **proxy** to a running REST server (never a second engine). `agent-trader mcp --embedded` runs the engine in-process for a single local agent (same handlers over `LocalService`). | D3's one-engine rule, D1's local convenience. |
| D19 | Tick size | 0.05 default for all; per-instrument override column; `tick_size_regime=NSE_2024` flag off. | Brief mandates 0.05. |
| D20 | Ticks in persistent event log | Not stored per tick (volume). Ticks are pure functions of `(seed, symbol, date, second)` so replay regenerates them; only 1-minute candles are persisted. | D2's performance point. |

Out of scope for v1 (agents get `UNSUPPORTED`): F&O, GTT, product conversion tool, corporate actions/dividends, auctions/short-delivery penalties, T+0 settlement, live broker routing (no adapter interface exists on purpose).

## 2. Value conventions

- **Money/price**: `Decimal` in engine, quantized to paise; DB `INTEGER` paise (`*_paise` columns); JSON number with 2 dp. Quantities: `int` shares (lot 1).
- **Time**: engine works in IST (`zoneinfo("Asia/Kolkata")`, fixed +05:30). DB stores `ts_utc_ms INTEGER` and `trading_date TEXT (YYYY-MM-DD)`. JSON: ISO-8601 with `+05:30`. `seq` (engine sequence) is the authoritative order, not timestamps.
- **IDs**: prefixed ULIDs. `exchange_order_id`/`exchange_trade_id` are 16-digit strings `YYYYMMDD` + 8-digit counter (cosmetic realism).
- **Enums**: uppercase strings as Indian brokers spell them: `CNC`, `MIS`, `MARKET`, `LIMIT`, `SL`, `SL-M`, `DAY`, `IOC`, `BUY`, `SELL`, `NSE`, `BSE`.
- **Instrument key**: `"NSE:RELIANCE"`.

## 3. Domain model (SQLAlchemy 2.x tables; Pydantic views mirror them)

**agents**: `id agt_`, `name` (unique), `kind` (LLM|BOT|OTHER), `status` (ACTIVE|HALTED|COOLDOWN|DISABLED), `halt_reason`, `halted_by` (AGENT|RISK|ADMIN|SYSTEM), `halted_at`, `halt_token`, `cooldown_until`, `starting_capital_paise`, `metadata` JSON, `created_at`.

**api_keys**: `id key_`, `agent_id` (null for admin), `key_hash` (sha256(pepper+key)), `prefix` (8 chars), `scopes` JSON [read, trade, admin], `created_at`, `expires_at`, `revoked_at`, `last_used_at`.

**risk_profiles** (1:1 agent): `max_order_value_paise`, `max_qty_per_order`, `max_position_value_per_instrument_paise`, `max_gross_exposure_paise`, `max_leverage` (Decimal), `max_daily_loss_abs_paise`, `max_daily_loss_pct`, `max_orders_per_minute`, `max_orders_per_day`, `max_open_orders`, `max_instruments_concurrent`, `max_consecutive_rejects`, `reject_window_s`, `duplicate_window_s`, `allowed_products` JSON, `allowed_instruments` JSON|null, `denied_instruments` JSON, `daily_loss_halt_mode`, `auto_resume_next_day` bool, `version`.

**instruments**: `instrument` (PK, "NSE:INFY"), `exchange`, `symbol`, `isin`, `name`, `series` (EQ|BE|BZ|SM), `sector`, `index_memberships` JSON, `tick_size_paise` (5), `lot_size` (1), `band_pct` (2|5|10|20|null → dynamic 10), `is_fno`, `mis_allowed` (false for BE/BZ/SM), `mis_margin_pct` (Decimal, default 20), `adv_qty`, `sigma_annual`, `spread_bps`, `depth_base_qty`, `prev_close_paise`, `active`.

**daily_instrument_state** (instrument, trading_date): `prev_close`, `open`, `high`, `low`, `ltp`, `close` (VWAP 15:00–15:30), `band_low`, `band_high`, `circuit_state` (NONE|UPPER|LOWER), `volume`, `vwap`, `last_tick_seq`.

**candles** (instrument, tf=1m, ts): o/h/l/c/v (paise). 5m/15m/1d aggregated on read.

**orders**: `id ord_`, `agent_id`, `client_order_id`, `exchange_order_id`, `instrument`, `side`, `product`, `order_type`, `validity`, `qty`, `price_paise?`, `trigger_price_paise?`, `disclosed_qty?`, `after_market` bool, `status`, `status_reason` (code or cancel reason), `filled_qty`, `pending_qty`, `cancelled_qty`, `avg_fill_price_paise`, `converted_from_market` bool, `triggered_at`, `version` (int, starts 1), `origin` (AGENT|SYSTEM_SQUAREOFF|SYSTEM_FLATTEN|SYSTEM_SETTLE), `source` (MCP|REST|SDK|SYSTEM), `reason` (≤2000), `strategy_tag` (≤64), `confidence` (Decimal 0..1|null), `parent_order_id?`, `risk_verdict` JSON, `request_hash`, `margin_block_id?`, `trading_date`, `placed_seq`, `updated_seq`, `placed_at`, `updated_at`. Indexes: `(agent_id, client_order_id) WHERE status != 'REJECTED'` UNIQUE (partial index; on SQLite via `sqlite_where`), `(agent_id, status)`, `(trading_date)`.

**order_transitions**: `order_id`, `seq`, `from_status`, `to_status`, `cause` (AGENT|ENGINE|RMS|SYSTEM), `detail`, `ts`, `version_snapshot` JSON (mutable fields after change). This is both the audit trail and the modification history.

**trades**: `id trd_`, `exchange_trade_id`, `order_id`, `agent_id`, `instrument`, `side`, `product`, `qty`, `price_paise`, `turnover_paise`, `fill_kind` (AGGRESSIVE|PASSIVE|AUCTION_OPEN|CLOSING_SESSION|SQUARE_OFF|FORCED_SETTLE), `slippage_ticks`, `charges` JSON (ChargeBreakdown), `charges_total_paise`, `journal_ids` JSON, `seq`, `ts`, `trading_date`. Immutable.

**charge_lines**: `id`, `trade_id?`, `order_id?`, `agent_id`, `kind` (BROKERAGE|STT|EXCHANGE_TXN|SEBI|STAMP|GST|DP|SQUAREOFF_PENALTY|IPFT|ADJUSTMENT), `base_paise`, `rate` (Decimal str), `amount_paise`, `schedule_version`, `trading_date`.

**margin_blocks**: `id`, `order_id`, `agent_id`, `amount_paise`, `kind` (ORDER|POSITION), `status` (BLOCKED|ADJUSTED|RELEASED).

**positions** (agent_id, instrument, product, trading_date): `buy_qty`, `buy_value_paise`, `sell_qty`, `sell_value_paise`, `net_qty` (signed), `avg_price_paise`, `realized_pnl_paise`, `blocked_margin_paise`, `squared_off` bool, `last_price_paise`. MIS rows reset daily; CNC rows are the day's delivery activity and migrate to holdings at EOD.

**holdings** (agent_id, isin): `instrument_pref`, `settled_qty`, `t1_qty`, `t1_settles_on`, `avg_cost_paise`, `blocked_qty` (open CNC sells), `realized_pnl_cum_paise`. `sellable = settled_qty + t1_qty − blocked_qty`.

**ledger_journals**: `id jrn_`, `agent_id`, `seq`, `ts`, `trading_date`, `kind` (FUNDING|MARGIN_BLOCK|MARGIN_RELEASE|TRADE|CHARGES|PENALTY|SETTLEMENT_UNLOCK|ADJUSTMENT), `ref_type`, `ref_id`, `memo`. **ledger_lines**: `journal_id`, `account`, `debit_paise`, `credit_paise`. Chart of accounts per agent: `CASH`, `MARGIN_BLOCKED`, `UNSETTLED_RECEIVABLE`, `HOLDINGS_AT_COST`, `CAPITAL`, `REALIZED_PNL`, `CHARGES_EXPENSE`. `post()` rejects a journal whose debits ≠ credits.

Journal templates:
- FUNDING: Dr CASH / Cr CAPITAL.
- MARGIN_BLOCK (order accept): Dr MARGIN_BLOCKED / Cr CASH. MARGIN_RELEASE: reverse (on cancel/expire; on fill, release the filled proportion before posting the TRADE journal).
- TRADE CNC BUY: Dr HOLDINGS_AT_COST (qty×px) / Cr CASH.
- TRADE CNC SELL: Dr CASH (proceeds × t0_pct) + Dr UNSETTLED_RECEIVABLE (remainder) / Cr HOLDINGS_AT_COST (qty×avg_cost) / Cr (or Dr) REALIZED_PNL (difference).
- TRADE MIS opening leg: no cash movement beyond the margin block (which moves to `kind=POSITION`). MIS closing leg: Dr/Cr CASH vs REALIZED_PNL for realized PnL; MARGIN_RELEASE for the closed proportion.
- CHARGES / PENALTY: Dr CHARGES_EXPENSE / Cr CASH.
- SETTLEMENT_UNLOCK (BOD): Dr CASH / Cr UNSETTLED_RECEIVABLE.

Derived funds: `cash_available = CASH`, `cash_blocked = MARGIN_BLOCKED`, `unsettled = UNSETTLED_RECEIVABLE`, `equity = cash_available + cash_blocked + unsettled + holdings_at_market + mis_unrealized`.

**events** (outbox): `global_seq` PK, `agent_id?` (null = broadcast), `seq` (per-agent monotonic), `kind`, `ts`, `payload` JSON. Written in the same transaction as the state change.

**event_log** (replay input): `seq`, `virtual_ts`, `kind` (COMMAND|TICK_BATCH|ROLLOVER), `agent_id?`, `payload` JSON.

**audit_events**: `id aud_`, `seq`, `ts`, `agent_id?`, `api_key_id?`, `request_id`, `kind` (REQUEST|RESPONSE|ORDER_TRANSITION|RISK_VERDICT|FILL|LEDGER_POST|HALT|RESUME|ADMIN_ACTION|SIM|SYSTEM), `payload` JSON (redacted), `reason`, `prev_hash`, `hash`. SQLite trigger `RAISE(ABORT)` on UPDATE/DELETE.

**idempotency_records** (agent_id, key) UNIQUE: `request_hash`, `response_status`, `response_body`, `expires_at` (24 h).

**halt_records**: `id hlt_`, `scope` (GLOBAL|AGENT), `agent_id?`, `mode`, `reason`, `actor`, `token`, `created_at`, `resumed_at`, `resumed_by`.

**agent_daily_stats** (agent_id, trading_date): `orders_placed`, `orders_rejected`, `consecutive_rejects`, `trades`, `turnover_paise`, `charges_paise`, `realized_pnl_paise`, `day_pnl_low_watermark_paise`, `start_of_day_equity_paise`, `halted_at?`.

**price_alerts**: `id`, `agent_id`, `instrument`, `above_paise?`, `below_paise?`, `one_shot` bool, `fired_at?`.

**engine_state** (singleton): `status` (RUNNING|HALTED|DRAINING), `seed`, `provider`, `last_seq`, `last_tick_seq`, `clean_shutdown` bool, `schema_version`, `run_id`.

### Invariants (asserted in engine debug mode, property-tested, reconciled at rollover)
1. `0 ≤ filled_qty ≤ qty`; `qty == filled + pending + cancelled`; `avg_fill_price == Σ(q·p)/Σq`.
2. `Position.net_qty == Σ signed fill qty` for (agent, instrument, product, date); `Holding.settled+t1 == Σ CNC buys − Σ CNC sells` (by ISIN).
3. Every journal balances; `CASH + MARGIN_BLOCKED + UNSETTLED_RECEIVABLE + HOLDINGS_AT_COST == CAPITAL + REALIZED_PNL − CHARGES_EXPENSE`.
4. Holding qty never negative; CNC SELL qty ≤ sellable at validation and at fill.
5. MIS positions are flat after the square-off sweep completes (or handled by `mis_leftover_policy`); none survive rollover.
6. `(agent_id, client_order_id)` unique among non-REJECTED orders; identical request_hash replays the same OrderView with `idempotent_replay=true`.
7. All prices tick multiples; all fills and LTPs within `[band_low, band_high]`.
8. Per-agent `seq` strictly increasing with no gaps; exactly one ORDER_UPDATE event per transition.
9. `(seed, event_log[1..n]) ⇒ state_hash(n)` is a pure function; same `(seed, instrument, date)` yields byte-identical ticks regardless of agents, subscriptions or clock speed.
10. Audit hash chain verifies.

## 4. Order state machine

States: `PENDING_NEW` (transient, in-memory only) · `REJECTED` (terminal) · `AMO_QUEUED` · `PENDING_OPEN` · `TRIGGER_PENDING` · `OPEN` · `PARTIALLY_FILLED` · `FILLED` (terminal) · `CANCELLED` (terminal) · `EXPIRED` (terminal).

Legal edges (anything else raises `IllegalTransition`, which the API maps to `ILLEGAL_TRANSITION`):

```
PENDING_NEW      -> REJECTED            rule/risk failure (reason = code); client_order_id NOT consumed
PENDING_NEW      -> AMO_QUEUED          after_market=true outside hours
PENDING_NEW      -> PENDING_OPEN        placed 09:00:00–09:14:59 (MARKET/LIMIT only; 09:08–09:15 also SL/SL-M accepted as PENDING_OPEN)
PENDING_NEW      -> TRIGGER_PENDING     SL / SL-M in NORMAL
PENDING_NEW      -> OPEN                MARKET / LIMIT in NORMAL (MARKET is momentary)
AMO_QUEUED       -> PENDING_OPEN        09:00:00 next trading day, after re-validation (MARKET/LIMIT)
AMO_QUEUED       -> TRIGGER_PENDING     09:15:00 (SL/SL-M)
AMO_QUEUED       -> REJECTED            re-validation fails at release (funds/band); reason RELEASE_REVALIDATION_FAILED
AMO_QUEUED       -> CANCELLED           agent
PENDING_OPEN     -> FILLED|PARTIALLY_FILLED|OPEN   09:08:00 call auction (section 6.3)
PENDING_OPEN     -> TRIGGER_PENDING     09:15:00 for SL/SL-M placed in buffer
PENDING_OPEN     -> CANCELLED           agent (allowed 09:00–09:08 and 09:12–09:15; not 09:08–09:12)
TRIGGER_PENDING  -> OPEN                LTP crosses trigger (SL→LIMIT at price; SL-M→MARKET), matched in same cycle
TRIGGER_PENDING  -> CANCELLED | EXPIRED
OPEN             -> PARTIALLY_FILLED -> PARTIALLY_FILLED -> FILLED
OPEN             -> FILLED
OPEN | PARTIALLY_FILLED -> CANCELLED    agent | IOC_UNFILLED | SQUARE_OFF_SWEEP | KILL_SWITCH | HALT_AND_CANCEL
OPEN | PARTIALLY_FILLED | TRIGGER_PENDING -> EXPIRED   DAY at 15:30:00; AMO/PENDING_OPEN unmatched at rollover
modify: allowed in AMO_QUEUED, PENDING_OPEN (not 09:08–09:12), TRIGGER_PENDING, OPEN, PARTIALLY_FILLED;
        version++, re-run rules+risk+margin delta; qty >= filled_qty; order_type LIMIT<->MARKET allowed, validity change not allowed
cancel on terminal: no-op success, {already_terminal:true}
origin=SYSTEM_* orders: not modifiable/cancellable by the agent (SYSTEM_ORDER_IMMUTABLE); skip agent risk limits
```

Terminal: `FILLED, CANCELLED, EXPIRED, REJECTED`.

**Agent state machine**: `ACTIVE → HALTED` (actor AGENT|RISK|ADMIN|SYSTEM) `→ ACTIVE` (self-halt: self-resume after 60 s with `halt_token` + acknowledgement ≥ 20 chars; RISK halt: admin, or auto-resume at next BOD if `auto_resume_next_day`; ADMIN/SYSTEM halt: admin only); `ACTIVE → COOLDOWN → ACTIVE` (reject storm, auto-expires); `any → DISABLED` (admin, terminal).

**Engine state machine**: `RUNNING ↔ HALTED` (admin/global kill switch/watchdog); `RUNNING → DRAINING` on SIGTERM (503 for new commands, finish tick, flush, `clean_shutdown=true`). Boot with `clean_shutdown=false` → `HALTED` (admin resume required unless `AT_REQUIRE_ADMIN_RESUME_AFTER_CRASH=false`).

## 5. IST calendar and session phases

### 5.1 Clock
IST = UTC+05:30, no DST. `Clock` port: `RealClock` (zoneinfo) or `SimClock` (settable, steppable, `speed` multiplier). The engine never calls `datetime.now()`.

### 5.2 Phases (per trading day; all times configurable; capability matrix lives in `market/phases.py`)

| Phase | Window | Accepted | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CLOSED` | weekends, holidays, and 16:00:00–08:59:59 on trading days | `after_market=true` only → `AMO_QUEUED` (max 20/agent); others `MARKET_CLOSED` with `next_open_at` | IOC rejected |
| `PRE_OPEN_ENTRY` | 09:00:00–09:07:59 | MARKET, LIMIT (CNC/MIS, DAY) → `PENDING_OPEN`; SL/SL-M/IOC → `ORDER_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED_IN_PHASE`; modify/cancel allowed | AMO MARKET/LIMIT released here at 09:00:00 |
| `PRE_OPEN_MATCH` | 09:08:00–09:11:59 | nothing (`PHASE_NOT_ALLOWED`) | opening price P0 published at 09:08:00; auction fills (6.3) |
| `PRE_OPEN_BUFFER` | 09:12:00–09:14:59 | all types accepted as `PENDING_OPEN` (broker queue); modify/cancel allowed | released at 09:15:00 to OPEN/TRIGGER_PENDING |
| `NORMAL` | 09:15:00–15:29:59 | all order types, DAY/IOC, CNC/MIS | continuous matching each tick |
| `MIS_CUTOFF` (sub-flag of NORMAL) | from 15:20:00 | new/modified MIS orders → `MIS_WINDOW_CLOSED`; CNC continues | square-off sweep starts at 15:20:00 (section 6.5); `RISK_ALERT` warnings at 15:10 and 15:18 |
| `CLOSE` | 15:30:00 | DAY orders → `EXPIRED`; closing price = VWAP of 15:00–15:30 ticks (fallback LTP) | holdings MTM at close |
| `POST_CLOSE` | 15:40:00–15:59:59 (default **on**, `AT_ENABLE_POST_CLOSE=true`) | CNC MARKET DAY only, filled at closing price | else `CLOSING_SESSION_ONLY_MARKET_CNC` |
| `EOD` | 16:00:00 | EOD batch (section 6.6) | then `CLOSED` |
| BOD batch | before 09:00:00 of the next trading day (run lazily at first tick/command after 16:00 of T) | settlement, band recompute | |

Muhurat/special sessions: calendar file `special_sessions: [{date, start, end}]` → a NORMAL phase in that window (default: none).

## 6. Exchange & broker rules

### 6.1 Static validation (`market/rules.py`, run for preview and place, all violations collected)
- Instrument exists and `active` → else `UNKNOWN_INSTRUMENT` (+`did_you_mean` from search).
- `qty` integer ≥ 1 and ≤ `AT_MAX_QTY_HARD=1_000_000`.
- Price/trigger present per type: MARKET (no price; if present → `INVALID_ORDER_PARAMS`), LIMIT (price), SL (price + trigger), SL-M (trigger only).
- Tick: `(price_paise % tick_size_paise) == 0` → else `PRICE_NOT_ON_TICK` with `suggestion: {price_floor, price_ceil}`.
- Band: price and trigger within `[band_low, band_high]` → else `PRICE_OUTSIDE_BAND` (+band values).
- SL relations vs LTP at placement (broker style): BUY `trigger ≥ LTP` and `price ≥ trigger`; SELL `trigger ≤ LTP` and `price ≤ trigger`; else `TRIGGER_ON_WRONG_SIDE` / `INVALID_LIMIT_VS_TRIGGER`.
- Phase matrix (5.2); `IOC` not in pre-open/AMO; MIS after 15:20 → `MIS_WINDOW_CLOSED`; `mis_allowed=false` (BE/BZ/SM) → `MIS_NOT_ALLOWED_FOR_INSTRUMENT`.
- CNC SELL: `qty ≤ sellable` → else `INSUFFICIENT_HOLDINGS` (with `sellable`). Naked CNC short → `SHORT_NOT_ALLOWED_CNC` (hint: use MIS).
- Funds: `margin_required ≤ cash_available` → else `INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS` (+`required`, `available`, `max_affordable_qty`).
- `disclosed_qty`, if given, ≥ 10 % of qty; informational only.

Bands: `band_high = floor_to_tick(prev_close × (1 + pct))`, `band_low = ceil_to_tick(prev_close × (1 − pct))`; `band_pct=null` (F&O) → 10 %, no flexing by default (`AT_DYNAMIC_BAND_FLEX=false`; when true, +5 % relax after 15 sim-minutes at the band).

Margin: CNC BUY block = `qty × price` (LIMIT/SL) or `qty × best_ask × 1.01` (MARKET/SL-M) + estimated charges; trued up at fill. MIS block = `max(20 %, mis_margin_pct, 1/max_leverage) × notional`; released on cancel/expire; converted to `kind=POSITION` on fill; released as the position closes.

### 6.2 Continuous matching (`engine/matching.py`) — runs once per tick per instrument with resting orders, orders in `placed_seq` order, and again immediately after any trigger conversion in the same cycle

Synthetic book from a `Tick{ltp, ltq, bid, ask, volume, ts}`:
- `spread = max(tick, round_to_tick(ltp × spread_bps / 10000))`; `best_bid = ltp − spread/2` (floor tick), `best_ask = ltp + spread/2` (ceil tick), both clamped to band.
- Ladder levels i = 0..4: `ask_i = min(band_high, best_ask + i × tick)`, `bid_i = max(band_low, best_bid − i × tick)`; `qty_i = floor(depth_base_qty × 0.6^i)`; `depth_base_qty` default `max(100, adv_qty / 375 / 4)`.
- Impact ticks for an aggressive order: `k = min(20, ceil(alpha × sqrt(qty / (adv_qty / 375))))`, `alpha = 1.0` (`AT_IMPACT_ALPHA`).

Algorithms:
1. **MARKET BUY**: for i in 0..4: `fill_qty = min(remaining, qty_i)`; `fill_price = min(band_high, ask_i + k × tick)`; if `fill_qty > 0` create one Trade (`fill_kind=AGGRESSIVE`, `slippage_ticks=(fill_price − best_ask)/tick`). If remaining > 0 after level 4: convert to LIMIT at last fill price (`converted_from_market=true`), status `PARTIALLY_FILLED`, rests. If the instrument is `UPPER` locked (`ltp == band_high`) at acceptance: convert to LIMIT at `band_high` with no fill, status `OPEN`, warning `CIRCUIT_LOCKED`. SELL mirrored (bid ladder, `LOWER` lock).
2. **LIMIT BUY** at acceptance and each tick: if `best_ask ≤ price` → aggressive walk over levels with `ask_i ≤ price` at `ask_i` (price improvement), no impact ticks; else passive: if `ltp < price` → fill remaining at `price` (`PASSIVE`); if `ltp == price` → fill `min(remaining, floor(ltq × 0.5))` at `price`. Never worse than `price`. SELL mirrored.
3. **SL**: `TRIGGER_PENDING`; BUY triggers when `ltp ≥ trigger`, SELL when `ltp ≤ trigger`; emits `ORDER_UPDATE(TRIGGERED)`; becomes LIMIT at `price` and runs algorithm 2 in the same cycle (may rest unfilled if gapped through — realistic).
4. **SL-M**: on trigger becomes MARKET and runs algorithm 1 in the same cycle.
5. **IOC**: run one matching cycle at acceptance; remainder → `CANCELLED(IOC_UNFILLED)`. IOC + SL/SL-M: IOC applies after trigger.
6. No Trade price ever outside the band; a LIMIT priced at the band while locked rests until unlock.
7. Partial fills → multiple Trades; each Trade gets its own statutory charges; brokerage is aggregated per order (6.4).

### 6.3 Pre-open call auction (09:08:00)
Simulator publishes `P0 = open` (7.2). Liquidity at auction is infinite. `PENDING_OPEN` MARKET orders fill fully at `P0` (`AUCTION_OPEN`); LIMIT BUY with `price ≥ P0` (SELL `price ≤ P0`) fill fully at `P0`; other LIMITs become `OPEN` at 09:15:00. Agent orders never move `P0` (documented simplification).

### 6.4 Charges (`ChargeSchedule` version `2026.1`, `market/data/charge_schedules.yaml`; `T = qty × price` per Trade; each line computed in Decimal and quantized to paise ROUND_HALF_UP; GST is computed on the **rounded** brokerage + exchange + SEBI lines of the same Trade)

| Line | CNC BUY | CNC SELL | MIS BUY | MIS SELL |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Brokerage | 0 | 0 | `min(₹20, 0.03 % × order turnover)` per executed order | same |
| STT | 0.1 % × T | 0.1 % × T | 0 | 0.025 % × T |
| Exchange txn | NSE 0.00297 % × T; BSE 0.00375 % × T | same | same | same |
| SEBI fee | 0.0001 % × T (₹10/crore) | same | same | same |
| Stamp duty | 0.015 % × T | 0 | 0.003 % × T | 0 |
| GST | 18 % × (brokerage + exchange + SEBI) | same | same | same |
| DP charge | 0 | ₹15.34 once per (agent, ISIN, day) on first CNC sell fill | 0 | 0 |
| Square-off penalty | — | — | ₹50 + 18 % GST = ₹59.00 per MIS position squared by the system | — |
| IPFT | 0.0001 % × T, **off** by default (`ipft_rate: 0`) | | | |

Brokerage aggregation: per fill, `brokerage_delta = min(20, 0.0003 × cum_order_turnover) − brokerage_already_posted`, so the order never exceeds ₹20. Same-day CNC buy+sell of one ISIN is re-rated as intraday at EOD (STT 0.025 % on the sell only, stamp 0.003 %, brokerage `min(₹20, 0.03 %)`) via `ADJUSTMENT` charge lines (`AT_CNC_SAMEDAY_AS_INTRADAY=true`). `AT_CHARGES_ROUNDING=exact|contract_note` (the latter rounds STT and stamp to the rupee per scrip per day).

Golden examples (tests pin these to the paisa):
- **A. CNC NSE**: buy 100 INFY @ 1500.00 → STT 150.00, exch 4.46, SEBI 0.15, stamp 22.50, GST 0.83 (18 % × 4.61) → **177.94**. Sell 100 @ 1520.00 → STT 152.00, exch 4.51, SEBI 0.15, GST 0.84, DP 15.34 → **172.84**. Gross 2,000.00; charges 350.78; net **1,649.22**.
- **B. MIS NSE**: buy 100 @ 1500.00 → brokerage 20.00, exch 4.46, SEBI 0.15, stamp 4.50, GST 4.43 → **33.54**. Sell 100 @ 1505.00 → brokerage 20.00, STT 37.63, exch 4.47, SEBI 0.15, GST 4.43 → **66.68**. Gross 500.00; charges 100.22; net **399.78**; +59.00 if system-squared.
- **C. Partial fills**: MIS BUY 300 fills 100@1500.00, 150@1500.05, 50@1500.10 → order turnover 4,50,010.00; brokerage total exactly 20.00 (deltas 20.00, 0, 0); statutory lines per Trade; `Σ trade turnover == order turnover`.

### 6.5 MIS square-off (15:20:00)
Cancel all open/pending MIS orders (`SQUARE_OFF_SWEEP`); for each non-zero MIS position place a `SYSTEM_SQUAREOFF` MARKET order (`fill_kind=SQUARE_OFF`, `reason="system: MIS auto square-off"`), post the ₹59.00 penalty per position; emit `SQUARE_OFF` events (STARTED/COMPLETED). Positions still open at 15:30 (circuit-locked): `mis_leftover_policy` — `CONVERT_TO_CNC` if `cash_available ≥ notional` (margin block consumed, holding created), else `FORCE_SETTLE_AT_CLOSE` at the closing price with a `FORCED_SETTLEMENT` audit + `RISK_ALERT` event.

### 6.6 EOD (16:00) and BOD batches
EOD: DAY orders already expired at 15:30; compute closing prices; net CNC buys → `Holding.t1_qty` with `t1_settles_on = next_trading_day`, avg cost recomputed (charges excluded from `avg_cost`, tracked in `avg_cost_incl_charges` view); same-day CNC re-rating adjustments; contract note materialized; `agent_daily_stats` closed; reconciliation (invariant 3, 2) → on mismatch `RECONCILIATION_MISMATCH` audit + global halt (`AT_HALT_ON_RECONCILIATION_MISMATCH=true`).
BOD: `t1_qty → settled_qty`; `SETTLEMENT_UNLOCK` journals; bands recomputed from close; `DailyStat` reset; RISK halts auto-resumed if configured; `start_of_day_equity` recorded.

## 7. Market data provider and simulator

### 7.1 Protocol (`marketdata/provider.py`)
```
class MarketDataProvider(Protocol):
    name: str; deterministic: bool
    def prev_close(instrument, trading_date) -> Decimal
    def opening_price(instrument, trading_date) -> Decimal
    def tick_at(instrument, trading_date, second_of_session: int) -> Tick     # pure for simulator
    def ticks_between(instrument, t0, t1) -> list[Tick]
    def quote(instrument) -> Quote; def candles(instrument, tf, frm, to) -> list[Candle]
```
Plug-ins register via entry point group `agent_trader.providers`. `yfinance_provider` (extra `[realdata]`) returns delayed quotes for `SYMBOL.NS`/`.BO`, sets `deterministic=false`, disables replay and marks `/v1/status.provider`.

### 7.2 SimulatedProvider (default)
- RNG: `SplitMix64` seeded with `sha256(f"{seed}|{instrument}|{trading_date}")`; one stream per (seed, instrument, date); tick `n` is the n-th draw, so `tick_at(second)` is reproducible independent of access order. (Optional numpy Philox when installed; same semantics.)
- Overnight gap: `open = clamp_band(round_tick(prev_close × exp(σ_d × 0.5 × z)))`, `σ_d = sigma_annual / √252`.
- Per-second GBM: `p_{t+1} = p_t × exp(−½σ_s² m(t)² + σ_s m(t) z_t)`, `σ_s = σ_d / √22500`; U-shaped `m(t)`: 1.6 for 09:15–09:45, 0.8 for 11:30–13:30, 1.3 for 15:00–15:30, else 1.0. Rounded to tick, clamped to band.
- Circuit: if the unclamped path exceeds the band, `ltp = band edge`, `circuit_state = UPPER|LOWER`, `ltq = 0`; unlocks when the unclamped path returns inside.
- Volume per tick `ltq = Poisson(adv_qty / 22500 × m(t))`; `bid/ask` as in 6.2; VWAP and 1m candles aggregated.
- Scenarios (`scenarios.py`, admin only, logged in `event_log` so replay reproduces them): `gap_open(pct)`, `vol_spike(mult, minutes)`, `lock_circuit(side, minutes)`, `illiquidity(depth_mult)`, `market_halt(minutes)` (index breaker: SEBI matrix 10/15/20 % → 45 min / 1 h 45 min / rest of day before 13:00; shorter after — forced `CLOSED` phase with reason `INDEX_CIRCUIT`, default off), `flat`.
- Tick cadence: `AT_TICK_INTERVAL_MS=1000` real-time; with `SimClock` the engine generates all ticks between the old and new time in one `advance` (batched, in memory), matching only touches instruments with resting orders.

Seed universe `instruments_seed.csv`: NIFTY 50 + NIFTY NEXT 50 on NSE, BSE mirrors of 20 of them (same ISIN), 3 scrips with 5 %/20 % bands, one `BE` series (MIS disallowed). Columns per section 3.

## 8. Agent interfaces

### 8.1 Common envelope (every surface)
```json
{ "ok": true, "data": {...}, "warnings": ["MIS auto square-off in 6m"],
  "meta": { "request_id": "req_...", "seq": 18233, "server_time_ist": "2026-09-15T14:14:03+05:30",
            "market_phase": "NORMAL", "agent_status": "ACTIVE", "engine_status": "RUNNING" } }
```
Error: `{ "ok": false, "error": { "code": "PRICE_NOT_ON_TICK", "layer": "EXCHANGE", "message": "LIMIT price 1234.02 for NSE:INFY is not a multiple of 0.05.", "hint": "Resubmit with price 1234.00 or 1234.05. The order was not recorded; you may reuse client_order_id.", "field": "price", "retryable": false, "retry_after_s": null, "suggestion": {"price": 1234.05}, "details": {...}, "errors": [ ...all violations... ] }, "warnings": [], "meta": {...} }`.

Error codes (closed enum; `layer` in parentheses): AUTH_INVALID, AUTH_SCOPE, RATE_LIMITED (retryable), IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT, VERSION_CONFLICT, VALIDATION_ERROR, UNKNOWN_INSTRUMENT, MARKET_CLOSED, PHASE_NOT_ALLOWED, ORDER_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED_IN_PHASE, MIS_WINDOW_CLOSED, MIS_NOT_ALLOWED_FOR_INSTRUMENT, CLOSING_SESSION_ONLY_MARKET_CNC, PRICE_NOT_ON_TICK, PRICE_OUTSIDE_BAND, TRIGGER_ON_WRONG_SIDE, INVALID_LIMIT_VS_TRIGGER, INVALID_ORDER_PARAMS, QTY_INVALID, CIRCUIT_LOCKED (warning-grade), INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS, INSUFFICIENT_HOLDINGS, SHORT_NOT_ALLOWED_CNC, RISK_MAX_ORDER_VALUE, RISK_MAX_QTY, RISK_MAX_POSITION, RISK_MAX_EXPOSURE, RISK_MAX_LEVERAGE, RISK_ORDERS_PER_MINUTE (retryable), RISK_ORDERS_PER_DAY, RISK_MAX_OPEN_ORDERS, RISK_MAX_INSTRUMENTS, RISK_INSTRUMENT_DENIED, RISK_PRODUCT_DENIED, RISK_DAILY_LOSS, DUPLICATE_SUSPECTED, AGENT_HALTED, AGENT_COOLDOWN (retryable), ENGINE_HALTED (retryable), ORDER_NOT_FOUND, ORDER_NOT_MODIFIABLE, ORDER_TERMINAL, ILLEGAL_TRANSITION, SYSTEM_ORDER_IMMUTABLE, UNSUPPORTED, INTERNAL. Every code must appear in `get_rules().error_catalogue` with a non-empty hint (contract test).

Conventions: `verbosity: compact|normal|full` on read tools (compact = short keys `sym, ltp, chg_pct, qty, avg, pnl`, nulls omitted; list tools default compact); `fields: [..]` projection; cursor pagination `limit` (default 50, max 500) + `cursor`; candles columnar. Tool descriptions follow WHAT / WHEN / RETURNS / COMMON MISTAKES, ≤ 120 words, snapshot-tested. `--tools core` subset: get_market_status, get_rules, search_instruments, get_quotes, get_state, preview_order, place_order, cancel_order, wait_for_events, halt_self.

### 8.2 MCP tools (`[R]` read/parallel-safe, `[W]` write)

**Discovery**
1. `[R] get_market_status()` → `{phase, is_open, trading_date, server_time_ist, seconds_to_next_phase, next_phase, next_open_at, next_close_at, mis_square_off_at, is_holiday, holiday_name, accepted_now: {order_types[], products[], validity[], after_market}, clock: {mode, speed}, provider, engine_status}`. *Call first in any session and after any timing rejection; tells you the phase and exactly which order types/products are accepted this second. When closed, use `after_market=true`.*
2. `[R] get_rules()` → rulebook: phases with times, holidays remaining this year, tick/band/product/order-type matrix, charge schedule with formulas, your risk limits, error catalogue. *Read once per session; also at resource `trader://rules`.*
3. `[R] get_calendar(from_date, to_date)` → `[{date, is_trading_day, holiday_name, confidence, special_session}]`.
4. `[R] search_instruments(query, exchange?, index?, sector?, limit=20)` → `[{instrument, name, isin, ltp, chg_pct, band_pct, mis_allowed, series}]`. *Resolve a company name to an exact tradable code like `NSE:RELIANCE`; always pass that string to other tools.*
5. `[R] get_instrument(instrument)` → full spec: tick_size, lot_size, band_pct, band_low, band_high, prev_close, mis_allowed, mis_margin_pct, is_fno, sector, index_memberships, circuit_state.

**Market data**
6. `[R] get_quotes(instruments[] ≤ 50, mode=ltp|quote|full)` → rows `{instrument, ltp, ltq, bid, ask, bid_qty, ask_qty, open, high, low, prev_close, chg, chg_pct, volume, vwap, band_low, band_high, circuit_state, at}`. *Prefer one call with many instruments over many calls.*
7. `[R] get_candles(instrument, timeframe=1m|5m|15m|1h|1d, count≤500 | from,to)` → columnar `{t[], o[], h[], l[], c[], v[]}`.
8. `[R] get_depth(instrument)` → 5-level synthetic book. *Rarely needed.*

**Account**
9. `[R] get_state(verbosity=normal, since_seq?)` → `{market: {phase, seconds_to_next_phase, mis_square_off_in_s}, funds: {cash_available, cash_blocked, unsettled, equity, starting_capital, day_realized_pnl, day_unrealized_pnl, day_charges, day_pnl_total, gross_exposure, leverage_used}, positions_mis[], holdings_cnc[], open_orders[], risk: {agent_status, halt?, limits_used: {daily_loss: {used, limit, remaining}, orders_per_minute, open_orders, gross_exposure, ...}}, leaderboard: {rank, participants}, events_pending, seq}`. With `since_seq`: only changed sections + `events_since[]`. *Your single source of truth; call at the start of each decision cycle instead of positions/orders/quotes separately.*
10. `[R] get_positions()` → MIS day positions with MTM; `[R] get_holdings()` → CNC holdings with `settled_qty, t1_qty, sellable_qty, avg_cost, ltp, pnl`.
11. `[R] get_orders(status=open|today|all, instrument?, cursor?, limit?)`; `[R] get_order(order_id? | client_order_id?)` → OrderView with `fills[]`, `charges`, `transitions[]`, `risk_verdict`, `reason`.
12. `[R] get_trades(from?, to?, instrument?, cursor?)` → Trades with `ChargeBreakdown`.
13. `[R] get_ledger(since_seq?, kind?, cursor?)` → journals with lines and running balances. *Every rupee movement is here.*
14. `[R] get_pnl(period=today|all|from,to, group_by=instrument|strategy_tag|day)` → realized, unrealized, charges, net per group, plus `post_mortem[]`: `{order_id, reason, strategy_tag, confidence, entry, exit, holding_time_s, net_pnl_after_charges, outcome}`. *Learn from your own trades.*
15. `[R] get_risk_limits()` → RiskProfile + `usage` + `headroom` + kill-switch state; `[W] set_risk_limits(patch)` — agents may only **tighten** their own limits (raising → `AUTH_SCOPE`).
16. `[R] get_contract_note(trading_date)` → trades + charge lines + totals (broker-style JSON).
17. `[R] estimate_charges(instrument, product, side, qty, price)` → lines, total, effective_bps, round-trip breakeven.

**Trading**
18. `[R] preview_order(<same args as place_order>)` → `{would_accept, errors[], warnings[], risk_verdict: {passed, checks: [{name, passed, observed, limit, hint}]}, est_fill_price, est_slippage_ticks, est_charges, margin_required, cash_after, exposure_after, breakeven_price, suggestion}`. *Side-effect-free dry run with identical arguments; use it to size orders or to understand a rejection. Does not reserve funds.*
19. `[W] place_order(instrument, side, qty, product, order_type, price?, trigger_price?, validity="DAY", client_order_id?, reason, strategy_tag?, confidence?, parent_order_id?, after_market=false, disclosed_qty?, allow_duplicate=false, wait_for_fill_s=0)` → `OrderView {order_id, client_order_id, exchange_order_id, status, version, filled_qty, avg_fill_price, pending_qty, fills[], charges, position_after, funds_after, risk_verdict, idempotent_replay, warnings[]}`. Description (verbatim target): *"Place a paper order on NSE/BSE cash equity. `instrument` must be an exchange-qualified code from search_instruments (e.g. NSE:TCS). `product`: CNC = delivery (100 % cash, no shorting, held past today); MIS = intraday (≈5× leverage, shorting allowed, force-closed at 15:20 IST, new MIS orders refused after 15:20). `order_type`: MARKET fills now at the current price; LIMIT needs `price`; SL needs `trigger_price` and `price`; SL-M needs `trigger_price` only. Prices are multiples of 0.05 and inside today's band. Supply a unique `client_order_id` (a UUID/ULID) — resending the same id returns the same order instead of duplicating; this is how you retry after a timeout. `reason` is required: one or two sentences on why you trade; it never affects execution. MARKET orders in NORMAL session return fills and charges in this response. A rejection returns `error.code` and `hint`; do NOT resubmit an identical rejected order — fix the input or stop; repeated rejections put you in cooldown. COMMON MISTAKES: bare company names; missing `price` for LIMIT; CNC SELL without holdings (use MIS to short); trading when closed without `after_market=true`."* If `client_order_id` is omitted the server generates one and warns.
20. `[W] modify_order(order_id? | client_order_id?, qty?, price?, trigger_price?, order_type?, expected_version?, reason?)` → OrderView. *Only AMO_QUEUED/PENDING_OPEN/TRIGGER_PENDING/OPEN/PARTIALLY_FILLED; qty ≥ filled_qty; pass `expected_version` from your last view to avoid clobbering.*
21. `[W] cancel_order(order_id? | client_order_id?, reason?)` → `{order, already_terminal}`. Idempotent.
22. `[W] cancel_all_orders(instrument?, product?, reason?)` → `{cancelled: [ids], skipped: [{id, why}]}`.
23. `[W] square_off(scope="ALL_MIS"|"ALL"|{instrument, product}, reason, include_holdings=false)` → placed OrderViews. *Fastest way to go flat.*

**Control & events**
24. `[W] halt_self(mode="halt"|"halt_and_cancel"|"halt_and_flatten", reason)` → agent status + `halt_token`. *Stop yourself if your strategy is misbehaving; reads keep working.*
25. `[W] resume_self(halt_token, acknowledgement)` → status. *Self-halts resume after 60 s with a ≥ 20-char acknowledgement; RISK/ADMIN halts say who can resume.*
26. `[W] set_alerts(alerts: [{instrument, above?, below?, one_shot=true}])` → registered alerts; fire as `ALERT` events.
27. `[R] wait_for_events(since_seq, kinds?=[ORDER_UPDATE, TRADE, RISK_ALERT, MARKET_PHASE, ALERT, HALT], instruments?, timeout_s≤30, max_events=50)` → `{events[], next_seq, timed_out}`. *Long-poll; returns immediately if events exist, else blocks. Use instead of polling quotes; ticks are excluded — use set_alerts for price levels.*
28. `[R] wait_for_order(order_id? | client_order_id?, until_status="terminal", timeout_s≤30)` → OrderView + `timed_out`.
29. `[R] get_leaderboard(metric=total_return_pct, limit=20)` → `[{rank, agent, return_pct, day_pnl, sharpe, max_dd_pct, trades, charges, violations}]`.
30. `[R] get_agent_profile(agent_id?)` → public stats.
31. `[R] explain_rejection(order_id)` → `{code, verdict, hint, what_would_pass: {max_qty_at_ltp, nearest_valid_price, ...}}`.

Resources: `trader://rules` (markdown), `trader://state` (JSON; `resources/updated` on each event for subscribing hosts), `trader://instruments/{instrument}`, `trader://calendar/{year}`, `trader://charges/schedule`, `trader://orders/{order_id}`. Prompts: `trader-briefing` (rules, limits, decision loop `get_state → reason → preview_order → place_order → wait_for_events`, stop on `AGENT_HALTED`), `order-checklist`, `post-mortem`.

Admin/sim actions are **never** exposed over MCP or to agent-scoped keys.

### 8.3 REST (FastAPI, `/v1`, OpenAPI 3.1 at `/openapi.json` carrying every tool description and the error enum)
Auth: `X-API-Key: <key>` or `Authorization: Bearer <key>`; admin routes need an admin-scoped key; admin keys cannot place orders. Response headers: `X-Request-ID`, `X-Seq`, `X-RateLimit-Limit/Remaining/Reset`, `Retry-After` on 429/503.

- Generic: `POST /v1/tools/{name}` (body = tool args; always HTTP 200 with the envelope).
- Aliases (proper status codes: 201 create, 200 replay, 400 validation/exchange, 403 risk/halt, 404, 409 conflict, 422 schema, 429, 503):
  `GET /healthz`, `GET /readyz`, `GET /metrics`, `GET /v1/status`
  `GET /v1/market/status`, `GET /v1/market/calendar?from&to`, `GET /v1/rules`, `GET /v1/instruments?q&exchange&index`, `GET /v1/instruments/{instrument}`, `GET /v1/quotes?i=NSE:INFY&i=BSE:INFY&mode=`, `GET /v1/candles/{instrument}?tf&count|from&to`, `GET /v1/depth/{instrument}`
  `GET /v1/state?since_seq&verbosity`, `GET /v1/positions`, `GET /v1/holdings`, `GET /v1/funds`, `GET /v1/ledger`, `GET /v1/pnl`, `GET /v1/trades`, `GET /v1/reports/contract-note/{date}`, `GET /v1/limits`, `PATCH /v1/limits`, `GET /v1/charges/estimate`, `GET /v1/charges/schedule`
  `POST /v1/orders/preview`, `POST /v1/orders` (`Idempotency-Key` header alias for `client_order_id`), `GET /v1/orders`, `GET /v1/orders/{id}`, `PATCH /v1/orders/{id}` (`If-Match: <version>`), `DELETE /v1/orders/{id}`, `POST /v1/orders/cancel_all`, `GET /v1/orders/{id}/wait?until&timeout_s`, `POST /v1/positions/square-off`, `GET /v1/orders/{id}/explain`
  `POST /v1/me/halt`, `POST /v1/me/resume`, `PUT /v1/me/alerts`, `GET /v1/events?since_seq&kinds&timeout_s`, `GET /v1/leaderboard`, `GET /v1/agents/{id}/profile`
- Streaming: `GET /v1/stream` (SSE; `topics=ticks:NSE:INFY,ticks:*,orders,trades,account,market,risk,halts,alerts`; `id:` = seq; `Last-Event-ID` resumes from the outbox; heartbeat 15 s; ticks coalesced to ≤ 4/s/instrument; a `{"type":"gap","from","to"}` frame when a bounded queue overflowed — order/trade/risk events are never dropped). `WS /v1/ws` with frames `{op:"subscribe", topics}`, `{op:"ack", seq}`, `{op:"ping"}`.
- Admin (REST + CLI only): `POST /v1/admin/agents` (returns one-time plaintext key), `POST /v1/admin/agents/{id}/keys`, `DELETE /v1/admin/keys/{id}`, `PUT /v1/admin/agents/{id}/limits`, `POST /v1/admin/agents/{id}/halt|resume|fund|disable`, `POST /v1/admin/halt|resume` (global, mode), `GET /v1/admin/audit?agent_id&kind&since_seq`, `GET /v1/admin/audit/verify`, `GET /v1/admin/engine`, `POST /v1/admin/sim/advance {seconds|to_ist}`, `POST /v1/admin/sim/set_clock`, `POST /v1/admin/sim/scenario`, `POST /v1/admin/sim/rollover`, `POST /v1/admin/sim/reset {seed}` (new `run_id`; audit chain retained), `GET /v1/admin/export?agent_id&from&to` (JSONL).

### 8.4 Streaming event kinds (outbox; per-agent `seq`, `global_seq`)
`ORDER_UPDATE {order compact, from, to, cause}` · `TRADE {trade + charges}` · `POSITION_UPDATE` · `HOLDING_UPDATE` · `FUNDS_UPDATE` · `MARKET_PHASE {phase, next, in_s}` (broadcast) · `CIRCUIT_STATE {instrument, state}` (broadcast) · `RISK_ALERT {limit, used, threshold 80 %|breach, square-off warnings}` · `HALT {scope, mode, actor, reason}` / `RESUME` · `SQUARE_OFF {started|completed, orders}` · `SETTLEMENT {items}` · `ALERT {alert_id, instrument, ltp}` · `LEADERBOARD {rank}` · `SYSTEM {clock, provider, scenario}`. `TICK {sym, ltp, bid, ask, ltq, v, at}` is stream-only (never in the outbox).

### 8.5 Python SDK (`agent_trader.sdk`)
`TraderClient(base_url, api_key, timeout=10)` / `AsyncTraderClient`; `TraderClient.from_env()` (`AT_BASE_URL`, `AT_AGENT_API_KEY`). One method per tool with identical names and keyword arguments (generated `_generated.py`), returning the shared Pydantic models: `get_market_status, get_rules, get_calendar, search_instruments, get_instrument, get_quotes, get_candles, get_depth, get_state, get_positions, get_holdings, get_orders, get_order, get_trades, get_ledger, get_pnl, get_risk_limits, set_risk_limits, get_contract_note, estimate_charges, preview_order, place_order (auto-ULID client_order_id), modify_order, cancel_order, cancel_all_orders, square_off, halt_self, resume_self, set_alerts, wait_for_events, wait_for_order, get_leaderboard, get_agent_profile, explain_rejection`. Client-side sugar: `events(since_seq, topics)` SSE generator with auto-reconnect + `Last-Event-ID` + `on_gap` callback; `ticks(instruments)` WS iterator; `run_loop(on_state, interval_s)`. Errors: `TraderError(code, message, hint, retryable, suggestion, details)` and subclasses (`RiskRejected`, `AgentHalted`, `MarketClosed`, `IdempotencyConflict`, `RateLimited`); retries only on `retryable` codes/429/503/connection errors with exponential backoff honouring `Retry-After`, replaying the same `client_order_id`; never on rejections. `AdminClient` is a separate class. `agent_trader.sdk.mcp_bridge` exposes a client as in-process MCP tools.

## 9. Guardrails

**Risk limits** (RiskProfile defaults; agents may lower, admin may raise; all reported in `get_state.risk` and preview verdicts, evaluated in fixed order, never short-circuited):

| Limit | Default |
|---|---|
| starting_capital | ₹10,00,000 |
| max_order_value | ₹5,00,000 |
| max_qty_per_order | 10,000 |
| max_position_value_per_instrument | ₹10,00,000 (notional at LTP incl. open orders) |
| max_gross_exposure | ₹50,00,000 (5 × capital; Σ|MIS| + holdings + open-order notional) |
| max_leverage (MIS) | 5× |
| max_daily_loss | ₹50,000 abs **or** 5 % of start-of-day equity, first hit; `day_pnl_total = realized + MIS unrealized − charges`, checked every tick and fill |
| daily_loss_halt_mode | `halt_and_flatten` (cancel all, square MIS at market; CNC untouched); `auto_resume_next_day=true` |
| max_orders_per_minute | 60 (sliding window; excess → `RISK_ORDERS_PER_MINUTE` with `retry_after_s`) |
| max_orders_per_day | 1,000 |
| max_open_orders | 50 |
| max_instruments_concurrent | 30 |
| reject storm | 10 consecutive rejects in 60 s → `COOLDOWN` 60 s on write tools (reads unaffected) |
| duplicate_window_s | 5 (same instrument/side/qty/product/type/price with a different client_order_id → `DUPLICATE_SUSPECTED` unless `allow_duplicate=true`, which is audited) |
| allowed_products | [CNC, MIS]; allowed_instruments null; denied [] |
| price_deviation_warn_pct | 5 % from LTP → warning only |

At 80 % of any limit: a `RISK_ALERT` event plus a warning string on every write response.

**Kill switches**: agent scope (self via tools; admin via REST/CLI; modes `halt|halt_and_cancel|halt_and_flatten`); global scope (`POST /v1/admin/halt`, `agent-trader halt --all`, SIGUSR1) — engine `HALTED` short-circuits all mutating routes with `ENGINE_HALTED` before the lock; tick loop keeps marking to market but does not match. Watchdog: tick thread stalled > `AT_TICK_STALL_S=15` in NORMAL → `/readyz` fails and global auto-halt `TICK_STALL`. Boot after crash → HALTED.

**Idempotency**: `client_order_id` (1–64 chars) per agent among non-REJECTED orders; identical `request_hash` → same OrderView, `idempotent_replay=true` (HTTP 200); different hash → `IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT` (409) with the existing order. REST `Idempotency-Key` on any POST/PATCH/DELETE stores body hash + response for 24 h. Modify accepts `expected_version` (`VERSION_CONFLICT` 409 with current snapshot). Cancel is idempotent. `square_off`/`cancel_all` accept `Idempotency-Key`.

**Rate limits**: token bucket per key — reads 600/min (burst 20/s), writes bounded by `max_orders_per_minute`, `wait_for_*` concurrency 2 per key, streams 5 per key, WS subscriptions 200 instruments, `AT_MAX_INFLIGHT_COMMANDS=200` → 503.

**Auth**: keys `at_<agentprefix>_<32 bytes base32>`, hashed with pepper, shown once; scopes `read, trade, admin`; expiry/revocation/last_used; `hmac.compare_digest`. MCP streamable-HTTP takes `Authorization: Bearer`; stdio proxy reads `AT_AGENT_API_KEY`. Separation of duties: admin keys cannot trade; agent keys cannot reach admin routes.

**Audit**: hash-chained append-only `audit_events` for every authenticated request/response (redacted), risk verdict, transition, fill, journal, halt/resume, admin/sim action, with the agent's `reason`. `agent-trader verify-audit`, `GET /v1/admin/audit/verify`. `sim_reset` never deletes audit rows.

**Concurrency model**: one process, one `Engine`, one `threading.RLock`; FastAPI handlers call engine commands via `run_in_threadpool`; a daemon tick thread every `AT_TICK_INTERVAL_MS` runs `advance_tick(now)` = advance simulator → release queued/AMO by phase → evaluate triggers → match → MTM → risk monitors → square-off/expiry/EOD/BOD scheduling; `seq` assigned inside the lock. Each command = one DB transaction (event_log row → state → outbox → audit → commit) committed before the lock is released and the response/events are emitted. Fan-out to SSE/WS/long-poll via `loop.call_soon_threadsafe` into bounded `asyncio.Queue`s. With `AT_CLOCK=sim` there is no tick thread; time advances only via admin/sim calls or tests. Uvicorn single worker enforced. SQLite WAL + `busy_timeout=5000`; Postgres via URL.

---

## 10. Sandbox safety
No broker credentials, no routing adapter interface. `yfinance` provider is read-only, disables replay, and is flagged in `/v1/status`. Every response carries `paper_trading=true` in `get_market_status`/`/v1/status`. Thesis/agent names are untrusted data (escaped, length-limited) and never fed back as instructions.

---

## 11. Observability & operations
structlog JSON (`ts, level, event, request_id, agent_id, api_key_prefix, order_id, seq, duration_ms, error.code`); Prometheus: `at_orders_total{status,product}`, `at_rejections_total{code}`, `at_fills_total`, `at_halts_total{scope,actor}`, `at_tick_age_seconds`, `at_engine_lock_wait_seconds` (histogram), `at_stream_subscribers`, `at_rate_limited_total`, `at_daily_pnl_paise{agent}`. `/healthz` (process), `/readyz` (DB ping, tick thread alive, tick age, calendar year loaded, migrations at head), `/v1/status` (phase, engine status, seed, provider, seq, version, git sha, paper_trading). Graceful shutdown via DRAINING. Alembic: `agent-trader migrate`; server refuses to start if DB not at head unless `AT_AUTO_MIGRATE=true` (dev default). CLI: `serve`, `mcp [--embedded] [--tools core|all]`, `migrate`, `seed`, `create-agent --name --capital` (prints key), `rotate-key`, `halt|resume [--all|--agent]`, `replay --log --seed --until`, `verify-audit`, `sim-day --date --speed` (runs a full seeded session), `calendar-check`, `config`.

## 13. Test plan

Principles: no wall clock, no network, no sleeps. `sim_env(seed=42, start="2026-09-15T09:14:59+05:30")` builds Engine + SimulatedProvider + in-memory SQLite + one funded agent; `tick_script` fixture feeds explicit `Tick` sequences; hypothesis derandomized in CI. `pytest -q` core suite < 60 s; coverage gate 90 % on `engine/` and `market/`; `ruff` + `mypy --strict` on `schemas/`, `tools/`, `engine/`, `market/`; a lint test greps money/price modules for `float(`.

**Unit**: `money` (paise round-trip, tick rounding modes, 1500.05 ok / 1500.07 rejected / float-noise 1234.0500000001 handled via string parse); `calendar`/`phases` (every 2026 holiday → CLOSED; weekends; exact boundary seconds 08:59:59, 09:00:00, 09:07:59, 09:08:00, 09:12:00, 09:15:00, 15:19:59, 15:20:00, 15:29:59, 15:30:00, 15:40:00, 16:00:00; next_trading_day across Fri→Mon and holiday clusters; special session; stale calendar refusal; `accepted_now` table equals the phase matrix); `bands` (2/5/10/20 %, rounding direction, edge equality, circuit transitions); `rules` (product × type × validity × phase table; SL relations; all violations returned together); `charges` (golden A/B/C to the paisa; ~40-case hand-computed table; DP once per ISIN-day; brokerage cap across fills; GST base excludes STT/stamp; contract_note rounding; same-day CNC re-rating; schedule versioning); `state_machine` (exhaustive (state, event) table; terminal immutability; SYSTEM orders immutable); `margin` (CNC/MIS amounts, market buffer, release on cancel/expire, partial-fill adjustment); `positions` (avg price, realized FIFO, MTM); `ledger` (unbalanced journal rejected; every template balances; reconciliation catches injected corruption); `risk` (one test per check with observed/limit; verdict lists all failures; daily-loss from unrealized MTM; reject storm; duplicate window; sliding-window rate); `killswitch` (modes, actor/resume matrix, crash-boot halted, tick-stall watchdog); `simulator` (same seed ⇒ identical ticks; adding instruments/subscribers doesn't perturb others; 1×22500 s advance == 22500×1 s; ltp within band and on tick; U-shape realized vol; gap within band; scenarios reproducible); `audit` (chain verifies; tampering breaks it).

**Engine** (SimClock + tick_script): MARKET walks ladder, partial → LIMIT at last fill price, IOC remainder cancelled, locked-side conversion to LIMIT at band; LIMIT price improvement, passive trade-through vs at-touch partial, never worse than limit; SL/SL-M trigger both sides, TRIGGERED emitted once, SL gapped past limit rests, SL-M fills with slippage, untriggered expire 15:30; pre-open rejections, auction fills at P0, buffer queue release at 09:15; AMO release and re-validation rejection; POST_CLOSE CNC MARKET at close, MIS rejected; square-off flattens long/short, cancels pending MIS, ₹59 penalty posted, MIS entry rejected after 15:20, leftover policy both branches; EOD/BOD: DAY expiry, t1 → settled across a weekend + holiday, BTST sell allowed, 80/20 holdback and unlock, same-day CNC re-rating; ledger invariants asserted after every engine test; 5-day multi-agent golden JSON regression.

**Property** (hypothesis): random place/modify/cancel/tick/rollover sequences preserve invariants 1–8; charges non-negative and monotone in qty/price; MIS brokerage ≤ ₹20/order; idempotent replay returns identical OrderView; request-hash conflict detection; public API paths never raise `IllegalTransition`.

**API** (httpx `ASGITransport`): auth matrix (missing/invalid/revoked/expired/scope; admin vs agent separation); idempotency (replay 200 + same body, mismatch 409, `Idempotency-Key` on cancel); `If-Match` conflicts; rate limit 429 + headers; full lifecycle place → advance → fill → positions → ledger → trades; daily-loss auto-halt with flatten; halt/resume matrix; global halt short-circuit; SSE `Last-Event-ID` resume and gap marker under a slow consumer; WS subscribe/unsubscribe; long-poll returns on fill and on timeout; health/ready/status/metrics; OpenAPI snapshot including the error enum; 100 concurrent `place_order` with one `client_order_id` → exactly one order; 50 threads hammering the API → no IntegrityError, p99 < 1 s.

**MCP** (`mcp` in-memory client session): `list_tools` snapshot (names, inputSchema, descriptions contain the four sections and fit the token budget); call every tool with valid and invalid args; business errors are `isError=false` envelopes; resources readable and `resources/updated` fires on fill; admin tools absent; `--tools core` subset; stdio proxy contract test against a mocked REST base.

**SDK** (respx + ASGI): auto client_order_id; retry only on retryable/429/503 with the same id; typed exceptions carry hint/suggestion; SSE resume + gap callback; `wait_for_order`.

**Contract**: registry → OpenAPI and → MCP schemas snapshots; `scripts/gen_sdk.py` output equals committed `_generated.py`; every `ErrorCode` present in `get_rules().error_catalogue` with a hint; `docs/RULEBOOK.md` regenerated equals committed.

**Replay**: golden `{seed, event_log.jsonl, expected_state_hash every 100 seq}` fixtures; fuzz test runs random agent command sequences live, dumps the log, replays, asserts identical `state_hash` and audit chain head; "kill during fill" (process killed between event_log write and commit) boots HALTED and replay rebuilds a consistent state.

**E2E**: scripted deterministic bot runs a full day in the seeded world (AMO overnight, pre-open fill, LIMIT/SL lifecycle, daily-loss halt and resume, 15:20 square-off, rollover), asserting leaderboard, contract note and `get_pnl.post_mortem`; runaway agent (1000 orders in 10 s → ≤ limit accepted, cooldown engaged, no over-limit position); prompt-injected agent key hitting admin routes → 403 everywhere; 5 bots in one seeded world see identical tick histories and independent fills. Optional nightly LLM eval harness (needs an API key; not gating): golden tasks through the MCP tool loop, measuring first-try `place_order` success, tool calls per task and reject count — used to hill-climb tool descriptions.
